tasks.corrected_reference_answer: KickHLSStream stores low_latency (src/streamlink/plugins/kick.py:118-124). Its worker sets reload_time to segment and retains prefetch segments only in low-latency mode (77-92). Its reader clamps hls-live-edge between 1 and LOW_LATENCY_MAX_LIVE_EDGE and enables hls-segment-stream-data before parent initialization (100-115). Those concrete settings affect how close playback starts to the live edge and how segment data is delivered; this code does not specify a generic smaller byte-buffer or partial-segment protocol.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: CookieExemptionReason represents protocol reasons a cookie otherwise blocked by 3PCD is exempted (src/streamlink/webbrowser/cdp/devtools/network.py:1482-1503). It enumerates None, user settings, metadata, deprecation trials, heuristics, enterprise policy, storage access, scheme and sandbox reasons. to_json returns the protocol value and from_json constructs the enum. The source documents this representation purpose, not a proof of completeness, backward compatibility or the policy rationale for each exemption.
